command_population.chroot: Enabled sudoers runchroot/CHROOT in either Defaults or a command specification changes the file object addressed by an absolute command pathname; any enabled runchroot observed by cvtsudoers therefore gives ERROR rather than checking the host-root pathname.
command_population.command_path_boundary: cvtsudoers JSON combines executable pathname and arguments and unescapes escaped whitespace in a pathname. The adapter therefore does not split at the first blank: it enumerates whitespace boundaries plus the full string against the fixture/host filesystem and accepts exactly one existing executable regular-file path prefix. Zero or multiple executable prefixes => ERROR, preventing a spaced pathname from being truncated to a different file.
command_population.cvtsudoers: The exact reviewed current sudoers tree is converted read-only with /usr/bin/cvtsudoers -c /dev/null -e -s aliases -f json. Defaults remain visible so runchroot cannot silently redirect command-path resolution; aliases are expanded by the sudo parser rather than reimplemented.
command_population.dynamic_forms: Positive ALL command, regex command, wildcard in the executable pathname, directory command form, relative/non-path command other than sudoedit, malformed JSON or unsupported selector shape => ERROR because a complete finite executable-file population cannot be proved.
command_population.execution_frontends: Known generic interpreters and execution frontends (including shell/language interpreters, env/time/privilege or namespace launchers, xargs/find, run-parts and similar execution envelopes) => ERROR after final symlink resolution. A resolved target with st_nlink != 1 also => ERROR so a hardlink alias cannot hide such a frontend behind a benign basename. This prevents a directly sudo-authorized execution envelope from yielding PASS while a downstream user-controlled file may be executed as root.
command_population.host_scope: All host-qualified rules from the reviewed local policy are conservatively included; this may over-approximate the current host but cannot omit a command because of host-name matching ambiguity.
command_population.invoker_scope: A user specification proven to name only UID 0/root as invoking user is outside this privilege-escalation population. Any specification that may include an ordinary invoking user is included.
command_population.negation: Negated command entries do not add a target. Positive entries are conservatively retained even if another rule may later negate them; over-checking is allowed, omission is not.
command_population.root_runas: Absent runasusers means root. Explicit root, UID 0, ALL, or an unresolved group/netgroup-style runas selector is conservatively treated as possibly root. A runas list proven to contain only explicit non-root usernames/UIDs is outside scope.
command_population.shebang: A selected executable whose bytes begin with #! delegates privileged execution to an interpreter. This v1 checker does not recursively model interpreter chains, so any shebang target gives ERROR rather than PASS after checking only the script inode.
command_population.sudoedit: The sudoers pseudo-command sudoedit does not identify an executable target file and is not added to the file population.

comparison.executable: Each selected path must resolve stably to an executable regular file. Missing, nonregular, non-executable, escaping fixture root, or target/link drift => ERROR.
comparison.mode: For every selected executable target, (mode & 0022) == 0 exactly represents the source chmod go-w operation.
comparison.owner: For every selected executable target, st_uid == 0 represents the source chown root operation. A non-root owner is VALUE/FAIL.
comparison.symlink: A selected symlink is checked through its final regular-file target, matching the file object affected by ordinary chown/chmod dereference semantics.

compliance.error: ERROR: reviewed sudoers authority unavailable/malformed; current visudo closure differs from the reviewed pathset/bytes; visudo/cvtsudoers unavailable or ambiguous; command population cannot be finitely resolved; target/source snapshot drift; target missing/nonregular/non-executable; selected target is a shebang script whose interpreter chain is not modeled.
compliance.fail: VALUE/FAIL when the determinate selected population contains one or more non-root-owned targets or targets with group/other write bits set.
compliance.pass: VALUE/PASS when the reviewed policy is current, command population is determinate, every selected target is stable, owner UID is 0 and bits 0022 are clear. An empty determinate population is PASS.

policy_prerequisite.meaning: SRC-0008 reuses the exact reviewed sudoers-tree authority already defined by SRC-0004 only as an observation-integrity prerequisite. Active visudo closure pathset and exact bytes must match it before command extraction is trusted.
policy_prerequisite.no_universal_policy: No universal approved users or commands are inferred from groups, donor defaults, environment, or VM state.

source_interpretation.population: Executable files named by sudo rules that may be invoked by an ordinary user with root runas semantics.
source_interpretation.scope: SRC-0008 / fstec-linux-2022 / 2.3.4 only. It does not replace SRC-0004 policy review and does not add parent-directory requirements from SRC-0006.
source_interpretation.source_operations: chown root and chmod go-w are represented as read-only predicates owner UID 0 and bits-clear 0022; CHECK performs neither operation.
